structural_fix: Generate the official Supabase CLI baseline from trusted default-branch workflow code; for the exact candidate-declared, effect-verified replay baselines, reconcile tracking with supported `supabase migration repair --status applied`, read the remote ledger back, and lease the resulting evidence to the exact recovery PR head.
invariants: no pull_request trigger on the production baseline capture workflow
official supabase db dump and migration list only
exact-head force-with-lease before writing baseline evidence
fresh replay and parity remain independently required
no production schema/data DDL/DML mutation; only bounded supported migration-history tracking repair
repair set must equal the exact effect-verified replay baselines and remote readback must prove each repaired version
recovery lock may become REPAIRED_APPLIED_VERIFIED only after official remote migration-history dump proves exact version/name identities
